mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, runtime_user_uuid, status, model, instructions, inputs, outputs, error, usage, output_memory_store_uuid, internal_session_uuid, created_at, updated_at, started_at, ended_at, archived_at, execution_state, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, claimed_by_worker_id, claim_expires_at, last_error
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dreams (uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, runtime_user_uuid, status, model, instructions, inputs, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID}, #{params.RuntimeUserUUID}, #{params.Status}, #{params.Model}, #{params.Instructions}, CAST(#{params.Inputs,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt}) RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dreams WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{externalID}
SELECT FROM dreams WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND internal_session_uuid = #{internalSessionUUID}

SELECT FROM dreams WHERE status IN ('canceled', 'failed') AND archived_at IS NULL AND internal_session_uuid IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sessions WHERE sessions.workspace_uuid = dreams.workspace_uuid AND sessions.uuid = dreams.internal_session_uuid AND sessions.archived_at IS NULL AND sessions.status IN ('running', 'rescheduling') ) ORDER BY ended_at ASC, uuid ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM dreams WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'canceled') AND internal_session_uuid IS NOT NULL AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM environment_work WHERE environment_work.workspace_uuid = dreams.workspace_uuid AND environment_work.session_uuid = dreams.internal_session_uuid AND environment_work.deleted_at IS NULL AND environment_work.state <> 'stopped' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sessions WHERE sessions.workspace_uuid = dreams.workspace_uuid AND sessions.uuid = dreams.internal_session_uuid AND sessions.deleted_at IS NULL AND sessions.archived_at IS NULL AND sessions.status IN ('running', 'rescheduling') ) ) ORDER BY ended_at ASC, uuid ASC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH changed AS ( UPDATE dreams SET execution_state = CASE WHEN internal_session_uuid IS NULL THEN 'preparing' ELSE 'dispatching' END, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, claimed_by_worker_id = #{params.WorkerID}, claim_expires_at = #{params.ClaimExpiresAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = ( SELECT uuid FROM dreams WHERE status = 'pending' AND archived_at IS NULL AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= NOW()) AND (claim_expires_at IS NULL OR claim_expires_at <= NOW()) ORDER BY created_at ASC, uuid ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) RETURNING ) SELECT FROM changed
mapper.update: UPDATE dreams SET execution_state = CASE WHEN internal_session_uuid IS NULL THEN 'queued' ELSE 'dispatching' END, next_attempt_at = #{params.NextAttemptAt}, claimed_by_worker_id = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, last_error = #{params.LastError,sensitive=true}, updated_at = #{params.Now} WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND status = 'pending' AND claimed_by_worker_id = #{params.WorkerID} AND archived_at IS NULL RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dreams WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'canceled') AND internal_session_uuid IS NOT NULL AND ended_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sessions WHERE sessions.uuid = dreams.internal_session_uuid AND sessions.workspace_uuid = dreams.workspace_uuid AND sessions.deleted_at IS NULL AND sessions.archived_at IS NULL AND sessions.status NOT IN ('running', 'rescheduling') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM environment_work WHERE environment_work.workspace_uuid = dreams.workspace_uuid AND environment_work.session_uuid = dreams.internal_session_uuid AND environment_work.deleted_at IS NULL AND environment_work.state <> 'stopped' ) ORDER BY ended_at ASC, uuid ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE dreams SET output_memory_store_uuid = #{params.OutputMemoryStoreUUID}, internal_session_uuid = #{params.InternalSessionUUID}, outputs = jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'memory_store', 'memory_store_id', CAST(#{params.OutputMemoryStoreID} AS text), 'internal_session_id', CAST(#{params.InternalSessionID} AS text) )), execution_state = 'dispatching', updated_at = #{params.Now} WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND archived_at IS NULL AND status = 'pending' AND claimed_by_worker_id = #{params.WorkerID} AND internal_session_uuid IS NULL RETURNING

UPDATE dreams SET status = #{params.Status}, execution_state = 'terminal', error = CAST(#{params.Error,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), usage = CAST(#{params.Usage,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), ended_at = #{params.Now}, next_attempt_at = NULL, claimed_by_worker_id = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = #{params.Now} WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND archived_at IS NULL AND status IN ('pending', 'running') RETURNING

UPDATE dreams SET status = 'failed', execution_state = 'terminal', error = CAST(#{params.Error,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), usage = CAST(#{params.Usage,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), ended_at = #{params.Now}, next_attempt_at = NULL, claimed_by_worker_id = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = #{params.Now} WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND archived_at IS NULL AND status = 'pending' AND claimed_by_worker_id = #{params.WorkerID} RETURNING
